metadata.article_title: District Authority to act in coordination with other agencies and be subject to directions given by the Central Authority, etc.

article.title: District Authority to act in coordination with other agencies and be subject to directions given by the Central Authority, etc.
article.content: In the discharge of its functions under this Act, the District Authority shall, wherever appropriate, act in coordination with other governmental and non-governmental institutions, universities and others engaged in the work of promoting the cause of legal services to the poor and shall also be guided by such directions as the Central Authority or the State Authority may give to it in writing.

Section 11 · Chapter III · page 9 of the Act

In the discharge of its functions under this Act, the District Authority shall, wherever appropriate, act in coordination with other governmental and non-governmental institutions, universities and others engaged in the work of promoting the cause of legal services to the poor and shall also be guided by such directions as the Central Authority or the State Authority may give to it in writing.
